words.example: Release of information requires the patient's written permission first.
words.exampleZh: 办理信息调取，首先要有患者的书面许可。

words.example: The family must sign an authorization form before we copy the chart.
words.exampleZh: 我们复印病历之前，家属必须先签授权书。

words.example: We do an identity check before any chart leaves this counter.
words.exampleZh: 任何病历离开这个柜台之前，我们都会做身份核验。

words.example: Please ask for the next of kin when the patient cannot sign.
words.exampleZh: 患者无法签字时，请询问近亲属。

words.example: The emergency contact written on the form is an old number.
words.exampleZh: 表格上填的紧急联系人是一个旧号码。

words.meaning: 内存亲和架构（Non-Uniform Memory Access）
words.example: NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) alignment matters on the wide HIS VM, or memory latency jumps.
words.exampleZh: 处理器很多的 HIS 虚拟机必须对齐 NUMA（内存亲和架构），否则内存延迟会跳上去。

words.example: The lab VM has eight vCPU and spends the morning waiting to be scheduled.
words.exampleZh: 实验室虚拟机有八个虚拟处理器，一上午都在等着被调度。

words.example: Give the HIS VM more vRAM before month-end reporting or it will swap.
words.exampleZh: 月末出报表之前给 HIS 虚拟机加虚拟内存，否则它会开始交换。

words.example: The guest OS on the lab VM is still the old build the vendor refuses to support.
words.exampleZh: 实验室虚拟机里的客户机系统还是厂商已经不支持的旧版本。

words.example: Patch the host OS only after the HIS VM has moved to the other node.
words.exampleZh: 等 HIS 虚拟机迁到另一台节点，再给宿主机系统打补丁。
